2.34.3.en: Geshur: a Hebrew name meaning "bridge." It is a district lying between Hermon and Bashan, bordering on Argob (1 Chr 2:23), and it lies east of Maachah within the portion of Manasseh.

2.34.4.en: He took Geshur and Aram: that is, Jair took the cities of the Geshurites and the Arameans, which became Havoth-jair, that is, the cities of Jair (Deut 3:14).

2.34.5.en: Aram Havoth: "Aram," which is pronounced "Aramu" in Akkadian, perhaps meant "the high land."

2.34.6.en: Kenath: it is present-day Qanawat in Hauran.

2.34.7.en: Machir the father of Gilead: a Hebrew name meaning "purchased." He is the father of Gilead, and his son's name was Abiah (1 Chr 2:21, 24).

2.35.0.en: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron's wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa. [24]

2.35.1.en: Ashur the father of Tekoa: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "blackness." He was the son of Hezron of the tribe of Judah, and his mother's name was Abiah (1 Chr 2:24). He is called "the father of Tekoa," and perhaps the inhabitants of his town Tekoa were of his descendants.

2.35.2.en: The expression [father of Tekoa] means the builder of Tekoa, which lies in the south of Judah (2 Sam 14:2, 4, 9).

2.36.0.en: 25 And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah. 26 Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam. 27 And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker. 28 And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur. 29 And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid. 30 And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children. 31 And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai. 32 And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children. 33 And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel. 34 Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha. 35 And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai. 36 And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad, 37 And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed, 38 And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah, 39 And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah, 40 And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum, 41 And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.

2.36.1.en: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were,

2.36.2.en: Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah. [25]

2.36.3.en: The sons of Jerahmeel occupied the region of the Negev, which is a desert region south of Judah.

2.36.4.en: Bunah: a Hebrew name meaning "intelligence." He was a man of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:25).

2.36.5.en: Orna or Oren: a Hebrew name meaning "laurel tree," or perhaps "camphor tree." This tree is known in Latin as Laurus nobilis, and it was the name of the sons of Jerahmeel of the tribe of Judah.

2.36.6.en: Ozem: a Hebrew name whose meaning may be "angry." More than one person bears this name, among them: 1. The name of a son of Jesse and brother of David, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:15). 2. The name of a son of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:25).

2.36.7.en: Ahijah: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "my brother."

2.37.0.en: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam. [26]

2.38.0.en: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker. [27]

2.38.1.en: Maaz: a Hebrew name meaning "wrath." He was the son of Ram, of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:27).

2.38.2.en: Jamin: a Hebrew name meaning "right hand of success." He was a man of Judah, of the house of Jerahmeel.

2.38.3.en: Eker: a Hebrew name meaning "uprooting." He was the son of Ram the son of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:27).

2.39.0.en: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada.

2.39.1.en: And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur. [28]

2.39.2.en: Shammai or Shumathi: one of the clans of the village of Kirjath-jearim (1 Chr 2:53).

2.39.3.en: Jada: a Hebrew name meaning "one who knows." He was the son of Onam, of the descendants of Judah, and his family was Hezron, of the house of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:28, 32).

2.39.4.en: Nadab: a Hebrew name meaning "generous." It is the name of a son of Shammai of Judah, of the sons of Jerahmeel the son of Hezron.

2.39.5.en: Abishur: a Hebrew name meaning "father of a wall or fortress." He was a man of Judah, of the clan of Hezron, of the house of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:28-29).

2.40.0.en: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid. [29]

2.40.1.en: Abihail: a Hebrew name meaning "father of joy." She was the mother of Amasa (1 Chr 2:17).

2.40.2.en: Ahban: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "the brother is wise or intelligent." He was the son of Abishur of the tribe of Judah.

2.40.3.en: Molid: a Hebrew name meaning "begotten." He was of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:29).

2.41.0.en: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim:

2.41.2.en: Seled: a Hebrew name meaning "exultation." He was one of the sons of Judah, the son of Nadab, and he died without leaving offspring (1 Chr 2:30).

2.42.0.en: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai. [31]

2.42.1.en: Sheshan: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "one who whitens." He was one of the descendants of Judah, of the clan of Hezron, of the house of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:31, 34, 35). He had no sons but daughters, and he gave his daughter in marriage to his Egyptian servant Jarha.

2.42.2.en: Ahlai: a Hebrew name that meant "Oh, if only!" The name of a person of the descendants of Sheshan appears (see 1 Chr 2:31, 34).

2.43.0.en: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan:

2.43.2.en: Jonathan: the son of Jada, of the descendants of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:32-33). It is a Hebrew name meaning "Yahweh gave."

2.43.3.en: Jether: a Hebrew name meaning "excellence." He was a man of the descendants of Judah, from Jerahmeel. He died without an heir (1 Chr 2:32).

2.44.0.en: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel. [33]

2.44.1.en: Peleth or Pelet: a Hebrew name meaning "swift." It is the name of a man of Judah, of the descendants of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron (1 Chr 2:33).

2.44.2.en: Zaza: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "movement." He was the son of Jonathan, and he was of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:33).

2.45.0.en: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters.

2.45.1.en: And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha, [34]

2.45.2.en: "Sheshan had no sons," whereas it is mentioned in [31] that the son of Sheshan was Ahlai. Perhaps Ahlai died without offspring before his father gave his daughter to Jarha his servant.

2.45.3.en: Some see that the reference to his giving his only daughter in marriage to an Egyptian servant, as a commendation of him, only reveals that this servant had accepted faith in the living God, and that he was marked by wisdom and virtue. It is as though his Egyptian (pagan) origin and his servitude did not make him lose his dignity, and were no obstacle to his eminence.

2.46.0.en: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai. [35]

2.47.0.en: According to the Mosaic Law, Hebrew women were not permitted to marry from outside the tribe to which they belonged, so that the inheritance might be kept within the tribe. Thus what Sheshan did appears to be contrary to the Law [36].

2.47.1.en: Harmer mentions that although this conduct appears contrary to the Law, it was the custom of the East that a person might be compelled to give one of his daughters in marriage to one of his servants, so that he might receive the inheritance, indeed even if he held a great position[15].

2.47.2.en: Attai: a Hebrew name meaning "suitable." He was the son of the daughter of Sheshan (of the sons of Judah), whom her father gave in marriage to his servant of Egyptian origin (1 Chr 2:34-36).

2.48.0.en: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad [36]

2.48.1.en: Nathan: a Hebrew name meaning "God has given." It is the name of the son of Attai and father of Zabad, of the family of Jerahmeel the son of Hezron, of the sons of Judah (1 Chr 2:36), and he was of the descendants of Caleb.

2.48.2.en: Zabad: a Hebrew name meaning "God has bestowed," or "gift." He was a son of Nathan the son of Attai.

2.49.0.en: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed [37]

2.49.1.en: Ephlal: a Hebrew word meaning "discerning." It is the name of the son of Zabad of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:37).

2.49.2.en: Obed: a Hebrew name meaning "servant." More than one person bears this name, among them: 1. The son of Ruth and Boaz, who was the father of Jesse the father of David (1 Chr 2:12). 2. The son of Ephlal, of the descendants of Sheshan, of the sons of Judah (1 Chr 2:37).

2.50.0.en: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah [38]

2.50.1.en: Jehu: a Hebrew name meaning "He is Yahweh." He was a man of the lineage of Judah, of the family of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:38).

2.50.2.en: Azariah: a Hebrew name meaning "whom Yahweh helped." More than one person bears this name, among them: 1. The son of Ethan, of the sons of Zerah, of the sons of Judah (1 Chr 2:8). 2. The son of Jehu the son of Obed, of the sons of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:38-39).

2.51.0.en: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah [39]

2.51.1.en: Helez: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "strength," or "(God) has saved; saved." He was a man of the sons of Judah, of the descendants of Hezron (1 Chr 2:39).

2.51.2.en: Eleasah: a Hebrew name meaning "God has made." It is the name of a man of the descendants of Judah and of the descendants of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:39).

2.52.0.en: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum [40]

2.52.1.en: Sisamai: a man of the tribe of Judah, of the family of Hezron, of the house of Jerahmeel (1 Chr 2:40).

2.52.2.en: Shallum: a Hebrew name meaning "recompense." He was a man of Judah (1 Chr 2:40-41).

2.53.0.en: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama. [41]

2.53.1.en: Jekamiah: a Hebrew name meaning "Yahweh rises up." He was a man of Judah, of the royal line.

2.53.2.en: Elishama: a Hebrew name meaning "God has heard." He was the son of Jekamiah, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:41).

2.54.0.en: 42 Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron. 43 And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema. 44 And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai. 45 And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur. 46 And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez. 47 And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph. 48 Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah. 49 She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa. 50 These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim, 51 Salma the father of Bethlehem, Hareph the father of Bethgader. 52 And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and Hazi-hammenuchoth. 53 And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites. 54 The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites. 55 And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.

2.54.1.en: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph;

2.54.2.en: and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron. [42]

2.54.3.en: The sons of Caleb [42]: he is the same Caleb mentioned in vv. 18-19. Here his descendants are given in more detail; perhaps they are his children by Jerioth his concubine, whom he had not mentioned previously.

2.54.4.en: Mesha: a Hebrew name meaning "salvation." He was a son of Caleb (1 Chr 2:42).

2.54.5.en: Mareshah: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "place of the head and the summit." It is the name of the father of Hebron (1 Chr 2:42), and he was of the offspring of Caleb.

2.55.0.en: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema. [43]

2.55.1.en: Korah: a Hebrew name meaning "baldness." It is the name of a son of Hebron, of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:43).

2.55.2.en: Tappuah: a Hebrew name meaning "apple." It is the name of a son of Hebron (1 Chr 2:43), of the descendants of Judah.

2.55.3.en: Rekem: a Hebrew name meaning "variegation, forming, coloring." A man of the descendants of Judah, from among the sons of Hebron.

2.55.4.en: Shema: a Hebrew name meaning "report." He is a son of Hebron of the tribe of Judah.

2.56.0.en: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai. [44]

2.56.1.en: Jorkoam: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "he enlarges the people." It is a village in the portion of Judah (1 Chr 2:44). Perhaps it was the village of Raka near Ziph, and some thought it the same as Jokdeam.

2.56.2.en: Shammai: a Hebrew name meaning "Yahweh Jesus." More than one person bears this name, among them: 1. The son of Onam, of the family of Jerahmeel, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:28). 2. The son of Rekem, of the house of Caleb, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:44).

2.57.0.en: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Bethzur. [45]

2.57.1.en: Maon: a Semitic name meaning "dwelling." It is the name of a son of Shammai of the tribe of Judah, and the founder of Bethzur.

2.58.0.en: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez:

2.58.2.en: Ephah: a Hebrew name meaning "darkness." More than one person bears this name, among them: 1. The concubine of Caleb, who bore Haran, Moza and Gazez (1 Chr 2:46). 2. The son of Jahdai, of the family of Caleb, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:46).

2.58.3.en: Haran: a name perhaps of Akkadian origin, meaning "road, caravan." It is the name of a son of Caleb and Ephah, of the family of Hezron (1 Chr 2:46).

2.58.4.en: Moza: a Hebrew name meaning "going out." It is the name of the second son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah (1 Chr 2:46).

2.59.0.en: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Gesham, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph. [47]

2.59.1.en: Jahdai: a Hebrew name meaning "Yahweh guides." He was a head of a people from the descendants of Judah, mentioned with the descendants of Caleb (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.2.en: Regem: a Hebrew name meaning "friend." He was a son of Jahdai, of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.3.en: Jotham: a Hebrew name meaning "Yahweh is perfect," or "Yahweh is complete." It is the name of a man of the descendants of Judah (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.4.en: Gesham: a Hebrew name meaning "filthy." A man of Judah, a son of Jahdai (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.5.en: Pelet: a Hebrew name meaning "God has set free." He was one of the sons of Jahdai the Calebite, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.6.en: Shaaph: an Aramaic word meaning "balsam." More than one person bears this name, among them:

2.59.7.en: One of the sons of Jahdai, of the sons of Caleb, of the tribe of Judah (1 Chr 2:47).

2.59.8.en: A son of Caleb by his maidservant Maachah, from whom came the inhabitants of Madmannah (1 Chr 2:49-50).

2.60.0.en: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah. [48]

2.60.1.en: Sheber: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "lion." He was a son of Caleb by Maachah his concubine (1 Chr 2:48).

2.60.2.en: Tirhanah: a Hebrew name meaning "favors." He was a son of Caleb the son of Hezron, and he is the brother of Berahiel by Maachah his concubine.

2.61.0.en: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea:

2.61.1.en: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa. [49]

2.61.3.en: Sheva: a Hebrew name meaning "hero," or perhaps it is close to the Arabic word "sawa'" ("equal"), in which case its meaning would be "like." He was the son of Hezron, of the house of Caleb, of the tribe of Judah. From his descendants came the Machbenites and the Gibeites (1 Chr 2:49).

2.61.4.en: Machbenah: the name of a city that is not known, whose location is in the portion of Judah; it was founded by Sheva (1 Chr 2:49).

2.61.5.en: Gibea: a Hebrew name meaning "hill." He was one of the descendants of Caleb (1 Chr 2:49).

2.61.6.en: Achsa: a Hebrew name meaning "anklet." She was the daughter of Caleb the son of Hezron (see 1 Chr 2:18).

2.62.0.en: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah;

2.62.2.en: Caleb the son of Hur: some see that this Caleb is a third Caleb. The first is the son of Hezron [18], and the second is the son of Jephunneh.

2.62.3.en: Ephratah: a different form of the name of Caleb's wife Ephrath [19].

2.63.0.en: And Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Bethgader. [51]

2.63.1.en: The writer was concerned with the descendants of Caleb because of the importance of Bethlehem, the place of the birth of the Lord Christ. Salma, one of the line of Caleb, is the founder, or father, of Bethlehem.

2.63.2.en: Salma: a Hebrew name meaning "clothed." He was the son of Hur, of the descendants of Caleb, and the father of Bethlehem, and some think that he is Salmon (1 Chr 2:51).

2.63.3.en: Hareph: a Hebrew name meaning "autumn, autumnal, harvest." A man of the sons of Caleb.

2.64.0.en: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons;

2.64.2.en: Shobal: the son of Hur, of the house of Caleb, of the tribe of Judah, of the family of Hezron. From his descendants came the inhabitants of Kirjath-jearim (1 Chr 2:50, 52).

2.64.3.en: Haroeh: a Hebrew name meaning "the seer." He was one of the sons of Shobal the son of Caleb, the father of Kirjath-jearim.

2.64.4.en: Hazi-hammenuchoth: a Hebrew name meaning "place of rest." It was a village inhabited by a son of Shobal, one of the descendants of Caleb (1 Chr 2:52).

2.65.1.en: the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites;

2.65.2.en: of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites. [53]

2.65.3.en: The Ithrites were a family that dwelt in Kirjath-jearim, while the Puhites, the Shumathites and the Mishraites were clans in the village.

2.65.4.en: The Zareathites: from the Zareathites (1 Chr 2:53-54; 4:2), the people of Zorah.

2.65.5.en: The Eshtaulites: a Hebrew name, perhaps meaning "the question."

2.65.6.en: The Zareathites and the Eshtaulites were in the south of Judah, on the border of the Philistines, and they are mentioned in the account of Samson (Judg 13:25).

2.66.0.en: The sons of Salma; Bethlehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites. [54]

2.66.1.en: The Netophathites: Netophah is a Hebrew name meaning "blistered," and it is a town in Judah near Bethlehem.

2.66.2.en: Ataroth: a town in Judea (1 Chr 2:54), near Bethlehem.

2.67.0.en: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites.

2.67.1.en: These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab. [55]

2.67.2.en: Some see that the author of the book was one of the scribes, and therefore he was concerned with the clans and genealogies of the scribes, such as those who dwelt at Jabez, since they are linked with the place of their dwelling because they are not known. They are Kenites who joined Israel through the marriage of Moses to a Kenite woman. They are sometimes referred to as Midianites (Judg 4:11).

2.67.3.en: The clans of the scribes: these are distinct from the company of the scribes who were of the Levites. It appears that writing was the craft of some clans, which the fathers handed down to the sons.

2.67.4.en: The Tirathites: one of the three clans of the Levite scribes, of the Kenites who dwelt at Jabez.

2.67.5.en: The Shimeathites: a family of scribes (1 Chr 2:55).

2.67.6.en: The Suchathites: a family of scribes, who dwelt in a place unknown to us today, named Jabez.

2.67.7.en: Hemath: a Hebrew name meaning "hot spring." He was the founder of the house of Rechab, a family of the Kenites.

2.67.8.en: The Kenites: they were not originally of Judah, but were among those whose land was given to the children of Israel (Gen 15:19), yet they united with Judah through friendship and marriage. The account of the Kenite scribes came within the genealogy of Judah. They are also linked with Rechab, the founder of the line of Israelites who were concerned with obedience to their fathers (Jer 35:1-9).

2.67.9.en: Hobab, the father-in-law of Moses or his relative by marriage, was with the children of Israel in their journey, and he settled in the south of Judah.

2.67.10.en: Also Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite killed Sisera, the commander of the army of Jabin king of Canaan, when he fought against Israel in the days of the Judges (Judg 4:7).

2.67.11.en: The house of Rechab: they are mentioned in (2 Kgs 10:15; Jer 35).

2.67.12.en: A pleasant journey with Judah and his brothers

2.67.13.en: v Grant me, with my father Jacob, to set out in flight!

2.67.14.en: Where shall I go, for my father and my mother cannot protect me.

2.67.15.en: Let Esau spew out all his venom; it will not harm me as long as I am in Your embrace.

2.67.16.en: I set out with Jacob on the road, as one who has been stripped of everything!

2.67.17.en: But You are the Way; I walk in You, and the gates of heaven are opened to me.

2.67.18.en: I do not need a pillow on which my head may rest.

2.67.19.en: I place a stone under my head with Jacob.

2.67.20.en: You are the Rock, who supports my head and sanctifies my thoughts.

2.67.21.en: I do not need a ladder by which to reach heaven, for Your cross carries me to the bosom of Your Father.

2.67.22.en: v You opened the gates of heaven to my father Jacob.

2.67.23.en: So he saw the angels ascending and descending.

2.67.24.en: By Your Holy Spirit You have established Your Kingdom within me, and so heaven has become in my depths.

2.67.25.en: The angels rejoice in Your Kingdom which You establish in me.

2.67.26.en: And I rejoice in the heavenly orders who rejoice in my salvation!

2.67.27.en: v How the soul of my father Jacob rejoiced, as he heard Your voice saying:

2.67.28.en: In thee and in thy seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

2.67.29.en: For I will not leave thee, until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of (Gen 28:14-15).

2.67.30.en: And I also, my depths rejoice in Your true promises to me.

2.67.31.en: "Behold, the kingdom of God is within you" (Lk 17:21).

2.67.32.en: Let me rejoice in Your Kingdom, which embraces the Gentiles and the peoples.

2.67.33.en: In You my heart is greatly enlarged, if it be possible, for all humanity.

2.67.34.en: I see You within me, embracing with love all the sons of men.

2.67.35.en: v You gave my father Jacob twelve sons, who establish tribes with one rejoicing heart (1 Chr 12:38-40).

2.67.36.en: Allow me to cleave to those who cleaved to You!

2.67.37.en: No tribe is without weaknesses, but Your grace has lifted all to You.

2.67.38.en: v The tribe of Reuben the firstborn: on its list is Reuben himself.

2.67.39.en: He fell into fornication with his father's concubine; he declined, for he defiled his father's bed.

2.67.40.en: He lost the birthright and the blessing, and destroyed himself by himself!

2.67.41.en: Your grace allowed him to be disciplined, yet from his sons there were found mighty men of valor, who cleaved to David the king and worked with him!

2.67.42.en: v Benjamin declined until he almost perished.

2.67.43.en: There were found among them wicked men who were called the sons of Belial (Judg 19:22).

2.67.44.en: They wrought an abomination such as had not been seen since the children of Israel came up out of Egypt (Judg 19:30).

2.67.45.en: Benjamin almost perished at the hands of all the tribes (Judg 20:21).

2.67.46.en: From Benjamin also appeared Saul, the first king of Israel.

2.67.47.en: He betrayed the Lord his God, and sought spirits instead of the Lord.

2.67.48.en: You were merciful, O Lord, to the tribe, and mighty men of valor were found among them.

2.67.49.en: They left their brother Saul the wicked, and cleaved to David wherever he was found.

2.67.50.en: And the tribe remained faithful to the tribe of Judah to the end.

2.67.51.en: There were found in the tribe of Benjamin those more faithful than Absalom the son of David!

2.67.52.en: Your grace raises up the fallen, and lifts up the contrite in heart.

2.67.53.en: Join me to Yourself, O Son of David, that I may cleave to You and never part from You!

2.67.54.en: Grant me to be faithful with You and to You, who are faithful forever, so that it does not concern me to belong to some tribe, for in the waters of Baptism You gave me the Spirit of adoption to the Father!

2.67.55.en: v If You count me a son of righteous Joseph the son of Jacob, grant me a portion with Ephraim or Manasseh!

2.67.56.en: Many faithful ones from the two tribes cleaved to David.

2.67.57.en: Do not deprive me of being among the heirs of God, heirs with You, through You and for You, for You are our eternal inheritance and our portion that does not pass away!

2.67.58.en: v I do not presume to count myself of the tribe of Judah or the tribe of Levi!

2.67.59.en: You have made me a king with authority, treading on serpents and scorpions and all the power of the enemy.

2.67.60.en: I defy the devil, sin and death!

2.67.61.en: For You are the Holy One and the Resurrection, the Giver of victory!

2.67.62.en: You have made me a priest to God Your Father in the waters of Baptism, accepting every word of thanksgiving or praise as an acceptable sacrifice before You.

2.67.63.en: v I do not enumerate all the tribes in order to belong to one of them, for You have made me a member of Your body, O Holy One.

2.67.64.en: You have become to me righteousness and sanctification and redemption! (1 Cor 1:30)

2.67.65.en: v You are wonderful, O Lord, in Your kindness and tenderness!

2.67.66.en: Many Hebrew women desired to bear children, that they might have the blessing of Your Incarnation from their seed.

2.67.67.en: Tamar the Canaanite was bitter of soul because she was childless.

2.67.68.en: Her husband Er the son of Judah died, and she bore no son.

2.67.69.en: She married his brother Onan, that she might bear a son for the dead.

2.67.70.en: She heard of Your Incarnation through the shadow, and longed that the blessing of Your Incarnation might come from her seed.

2.67.71.en: Her father-in-law Judah kept her from marrying the third son Shelah, for he thought that Tamar was the cause of the death of his two sons Er and Onan.

2.67.72.en: By a ruse she took on the likeness of shame, and assumed the position of a harlot.

2.67.73.en: She lay with her father-in-law, and he did not know who she was.

2.67.74.en: She conceived and bore, and obtained the desire of her heart.

2.67.75.en: The Canaanite woman surpassed many of the believing Hebrew women.

2.67.76.en: She bore two children who represent the Gentiles who were able to believe in the Messiah.

2.67.77.en: She bore Zerah, who lost the birthright, representing the Jews who refuse to believe in the Savior.

2.67.78.en: And she bore Perez, who seized the birthright while in his mother's womb, and became a representative of the Gentiles who accepted faith in the Savior of the world.

2.67.79.en: Kindle my heart with longing and fill it with hope, that I may be at Your right hand.

2.67.80.en: Your voice resounds in my depths: Come to Me, you blessed of My Father!

2.67.81.en: v Do I have the heart of Boaz, the simple one and servant of the needy?

2.67.82.en: He did not despise Ruth because she was a Moabitess, nor because she was poor.

2.67.83.en: He cared for her and for her mother-in-law, and received exceeding honor.

2.67.84.en: He became the grandfather of David, great among the prophets and kings.

2.67.85.en: Grant me a heart that loves every needy one.

2.67.86.en: Then You will satisfy my need, and bestow on me fellowship in Your glories!
